_about: Machine-checkable assertions derived from each case rubric, plus a golden reference_output that satisfies them. run_functional.py --selftest scores the references offline (CI-safe); --model scores live skill output. 'body' checks run on the extracted compressed body; 'full' checks run on the whole output. require_regex is case-insensitive.
